articles.summary: Company to Host Conference Call on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at 8:30 am Eastern Time Orthofix Medical Inc . (NASDAQ:OFIX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced that it will release its second quarter 2026 financial results on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, before market open. The Company will host a conference call and webcast to review results at 8:30 am Eastern Time the same day. Interested parties may access the conference call by dialing (888) 596-4144 in the U.S., and (646) 968-2525 in all other locations, and referencing the conference ID 8700861. A webcast of the conference call and a copy of the release may be accessed at ir.Orthofix.com.
